0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030REPLICATALK_00176_HUBAIRTIN_000_000
0.description: Advanced materia melding is a highly unstable process. There <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> be a way to harness the stones' power without risking their destruction...

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030REPLICATALK_00176_HUBAIRTIN_000_030
1.description: When a sphere scroll is fully infused with materia, it will shine as the stars in the heavens. This is the sign that its power is ready to be transferred to a suitable vessel.

2.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030REPLICATALK_00176_HUBAIRTIN_000_050
2.description: By the gods, you...you've succeeded! <hex:021A020203>We've<hex:021A020103> succeeded! To think that my efforts have finally borne fruit... No words can express the joy I feel at this moment.

3.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030REPLICATALK_00176_HUBAIRTIN_000_051
3.description: To be sure, my research is far from over. Much and more must be verified before I can form my conclusions, and so I would be much obliged for our ongoing collaboration.

4.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON030REPLICATALK_00176_HUBAIRTIN_000_052
4.description: If you have a mind to enhance another relic, bring me the requisite amount of superior enchanted ink, and I shall prepare for you a suitable sphere scroll.
